study.identity_notes: AbstractITT174 vs tablesn158. Registry open-label actual-point nonpowered acupuncture once/day vs paper nonpenetrating nonpoint sham and4sessions. General anesthesia unconfirmed; cesarean surgery alone not sufficient eligibility evidence.
